title: Detailed snowman
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- snow ground shadows -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="92" rx="38" ry="6" fill="#8fd3ff" opacity="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- bottom snowball -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="78" r="18" fill="#e8f4ff"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="78" r="18" fill="none" stroke="#b8dfff" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- shading on bottom ball -->
  <path d="M 35 84 Q 50 92 65 84" fill="none" stroke="#b8dfff" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <!-- middle snowball -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="56" r="14" fill="#f0f8ff"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="56" r="14" fill="none" stroke="#b8dfff" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <!-- head snowball -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="36" r="11" fill="#f5fbff"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="36" r="11" fill="none" stroke="#b8dfff" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <!-- hat brim -->
  <rect x="39" y="24" width="22" height="3.5" rx="1.5" fill="#2a3550"/>
  <!-- hat top -->
  <rect x="43" y="10" width="14" height="15" rx="2" fill="#2a3550"/>
  <!-- hat band -->
  <rect x="43" y="20" width="14" height="3" fill="#ff5d73"/>
  <!-- hat highlight -->
  <rect x="45" y="12" width="3" height="9" rx="1" fill="#4a5570" opacity="0.7"/>
  
  <!-- eyes - coal -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="33" r="1.8" fill="#3a4560"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="33" r="1.8" fill="#3a4560"/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx="46.6" cy="32.4" r="0.6" fill="#aaccee"/>
  <circle cx="54.6" cy="32.4" r="0.6" fill="#aaccee"/>
  
  <!-- carrot nose -->
  <polygon points="50,36 50,38.5 58,37.5" fill="#ff8c2a"/>
  <polygon points="50,36 50,38.5 58,37.5" fill="none" stroke="#ffaa55" stroke-width="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- smile - coal dots -->
  <circle cx="44.5" cy="41" r="1.1" fill="#3a4560"/>
  <circle cx="47.5" cy="42.5" r="1.1" fill="#3a4560"/>
  <circle cx="50.5" cy="43" r="1.1" fill="#3a4560"/>
  <circle cx="53.5" cy="42.5" r="1.1" fill="#3a4560"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="41" r="1.1" fill="#3a4560"/>
  
  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d="M 40 44 Q 50 48 60 44 L 60 47 Q 50 51 40 47 Z" fill="#ff5d73"/>
  <path d="M 58 46 Q 64 50 62 58 Q 61 60 59 59 Q 60 52 56 47 Z" fill="#ff5d73"/>
  <!-- scarf stripes -->
  <rect x="47" y="44.5" width="2" height="4" fill="#ffd166" transform="rotate(-3 48 46)"/>
  <rect x="52" y="44.5" width="2" height="4" fill="#ffd166" transform="rotate(3 53 46)"/>
  <rect x="59" y="50" width="2" height="2.5" fill="#ffd166" transform="rotate(10 60 51)"/>
  
  <!-- middle buttons -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="52" r="1.5" fill="#3a4560"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="1.5" fill="#3a4560"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="64" r="1.5" fill="#3a4560"/>
  
  <!-- arms - branches -->
  <!-- left arm -->
  <path d="M 36 56 L 22 46" stroke="#6b4226" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M 28 51 L 24 55" stroke="#6b4226" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M 25 48 L 21 50" stroke="#6b4226" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <!-- right arm -->
  <path d="M 64 56 L 80 46" stroke="#6b4226" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M 72 51 L 77 55" stroke="#6b4226" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M 75 48 L 79 50" stroke="#6b4226" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  
  <!-- snowflakes -->
  <g fill="#cceeff" opacity="0.8">
    <circle cx="18" cy="22" r="1"/>
    <circle cx="82" cy="30" r="1"/>
    <circle cx="12" cy="60" r="1"/>
    <circle cx="88" cy="65" r="1"/>
    <circle cx="25" cy="14" r="0.8"/>
    <circle cx="75" cy="16" r="0.8"/>
    <circle cx="85" cy="48" r="0.9"/>
    <circle cx="15" cy="40" r="0.9"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- snowflake stars -->
  <g stroke="#ddeeff" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.7">
    <line x1="70" y1="8" x2="74" y2="8"/>
    <line x1="72" y1="6" x2="72" y2="10"/>
    <line x1="30" y1="20" x2="34" y2="20"/>
    <line x1="32" y1="18" x2="32" y2="22"/>
    <line x1="80" y1="72" x2="84" y2="72"/>
    <line x1="82" y1="70" x2="82" y2="74"/>
  </g>
</svg>
